purpose: Clean prospective validation of the frozen own-model challenger; external Delta is observed only after the complete local result is sealed.

frozen_economics.model: HistGradientBoostingClassifier; learning_rate=0.05; max_iter=100; max_depth=2; min_samples_leaf=50; l2_regularization=10; random_state=20260811; expanding training; minimum 52 fully-realized weeks; retrain every 13 scoring weeks
frozen_economics.universe: point-in-time CMC Top-150 snapshot demonstrably available by Thursday signal close; complete feature row required
frozen_economics.liquidity: logvol30=log1p(median(last 30 source-specific volume_usd observations)); threshold effectively USD 10,000,000/day
frozen_economics.portfolio: weekly Thursday signal / Friday entry; 10 equal longs and 10 equal shorts; unscaled gross +0.50/-0.50
frozen_economics.risk: 13-week realized-vol lookback; 20% annualized target; max exposure 1.0; no leverage above 1x
frozen_economics.cost: 15 bps * turnover primary; 30/50 bps stress only
frozen_economics.funding: actual Binance USD-M funding; contribution per short = 0.05 * sealed exposure * realized funding_rate_sum

thursday_signal_gate: Use only information demonstrably available by Thursday UTC close.
Raw CMC universe snapshot and a separate availability/source evidence manifest are mandatory; both are SHA-256 sealed and the raw snapshot hash must match the evidence manifest.
Feature panel may not contain rows after signal_date; shortability input at signal stage may contain only strictly historical rows.
Seal the complete eligible score map plus independent long_ranking_desc and short_ranking_asc; do not infer one ranking by reversing the other.
Seal preliminary_longs_10 exactly from the frozen long ranking and seal exposure/trailing-vol/prior-weight risk state.
Friday shortability and external Delta are forbidden at signal construction.
friday_pre_entry_gate: Binance Spot and USD-M exchangeInfo payloads must be preserved/hash-bound and carry serverTime on/after SIGNAL_SEAL creation and strictly before Friday UTC close.
Selected longs require Binance Spot USDT TRADING evidence; an unavailable selected long BLOCKS instead of being replaced.
Traverse the sealed short_ranking_asc in order and select exactly the first 10 causally verifiably shortable USD-M perpetual names; stop at the 10th.
Seal exact instruments, exposure, trailing volatility, turnover estimate and frozen 15 bps cost assumption before entry close.
result_evidence_gate: Result evidence is generated only from the exact V16B_ENTRY_SEAL holdings and instruments.
Price evidence uses Binance Data Vision daily 1d archives for exact Spot/USD-M entry instruments plus BTCUSDT Spot benchmark; every ZIP must match its adjacent CHECKSUM and raw ZIPs are preserved.
The result builder reparses every preserved price ZIP; manifest close and timestamps must equal raw archive contents.
Funding evidence uses Binance Data Vision USD-M fundingRate archives; every required symbol-month ZIP must match its adjacent CHECKSUM and be preserved.
If a required funding archive has not yet been published, evidence remains PENDING/FAIL_CLOSED and zero funding is never synthesized.
The result builder reparses raw funding ZIPs and recomputes event count, funding_rate_sum, first_event_ms and last_event_ms; summary CSV values must agree exactly.
Per-asset weights are recomputed as +0.05*exposure for longs and -0.05*exposure for shorts; transaction cost is recomputed as 0.0015*sealed turnover.
Net PnL is recomputed as gross long + gross short + realized short funding - transaction cost; BTC benchmark return is recomputed from preserved BTCUSDT closes.
Manual PnL input is not allowed.
benchmark_comparison_gate: Only after V16B_RESULT_SEAL may a new external Delta checkpoint be attached.
The Delta attachment references the result seal hash and cannot alter any prior local evidence.
External Delta is benchmark evidence only and may never trigger parameter changes in this candidate.
promotion_minimum: No promotion based on a single week or the historical 11-week print. Capital approval requires separate venue/capacity/margin/operations review and explicit authorization.
